Richard Schoch is Professor of the History of Culture at Queen Mary, University of London, where he is also Director of the Graduate School in Humanities and Social Sciences. He is the author of Shakespeare's Victorian Stage: Performing History in the Theatre of Charles Kean (1998), Not Shakespeare: Bardolatry and Burlesque in the Nineteenth Century (2006), and Queen Victoria and the Theatre of her Age (2004). He has received fellowships from The Leverhulme Trust, Folger Shakespeare Library and the American Society for Theatre Research. His current projects are on Victorian Shakespeare and the cultural history of letter writing.
